headline: Mon Oct 26: NFL 1-0 (McKee under 1.5 TDs), NBA 2-1; every NBA lean 66%, 70%+ leans 83%.

findings: Monday night: Tanner McKee under 1.5 passing TDs (72%) hit. He threw 1.
That closed Week 7 with the top 10 at 10-2 and picks of the day at 3-1.

Week 7 misses: Tony Pollard under 68.5 rushing yards (75% sure; he ran for 129), Adonai Mitchell over 25.5 receiving yards (73%; 0 catches) and Aaron Jones over 38.5 rushing yards (78%, pick of the day; 26 yards).
model: Every graded NFL pick so far, long-shot TDs included: 239 of 529 hit (45%) vs the 43% the model expected, so it was slightly better than calibrated.
London (PIT-NO, hand-checked): leans went 14-5, and the Strong/Solid tiers went 7-0.
postgame: We re-ran 13 Week 7 games with what really happened. The rushing yards miss falls from 29 to 14 yards once each player's real role is known, so the misses were mostly about who got the carries, not how well they ran.
Carry share has run about 3 points above our pregame inputs over 90 players, which is the skew to watch.
Running back target share was set too low (Dowdle 11% vs 21% actual, Kamara 11% vs 18%), and inactive backup QBs were wrongly given carries.
improving: The model retested three efficiency corrections on 25 recent weeks: catch rate (+0.0004), yards per target (−0.0004) and yards per carry (+0.0005). None gave a reliable gain, so none was adopted.
Adopted from the re-sims: teams throw 2.9% more passes (x1.029) than the inputs said, which is built into the Week 8 sims.
The simulation blend stays on for carries, rushing yards, rush+rec yards, receptions and receiving yards, where it beat the model alone on unseen weeks. It stays off for passing stats.

findings: No college games Monday. Saturday's top 10 went 15-3 and picks of the day 3-0 (Texas State, Arizona, Kentucky).
model: Week totals on all 51 games with a posted line went 22-28-1. The model's suggested totals (Lean/Strong) went 8-5, but the near coin flips went 14-22-1, which is why they're never suggested.
The model's totals miss (12.2 points) equals the closing line's. The edge is against opening totals (Strong 59% all-time, 55% this season).
postgame: Air Force at Wyoming (14-28): Air Force ran 78 plays with 3 turnovers and Wyoming averaged 7.3 yards per play. With those inputs the re-sim had Wyoming by 7, so the miss came from turnovers and explosive plays.
improving: Tested and rejected in Monday's review: recent defensive form in totals (about 0 correlation), pace x explosive matchups for shootouts (no signal), and QB changes known before kickoff. The apparent effect of a new starter was really mid-game injuries.
Fixed how picks are graded: Saturday games had been graded on Friday's frozen numbers. Grading now uses the numbers the model had at kickoff.
Next tests: lock totals at the earliest posted line.

findings: Top 10: Christian Braun under 1.5 threes (68%) hit. He made 1.
Picks of the day 1-1: Stephen Curry under 4.5 threes (80%) hit with 3. P.J. Washington under 2.5 threes (81%) missed with 4, playing 41 minutes vs 32 projected.
Javon Small (pick of the day) never played. He'll be void and won't count.
model: Every lean the model made on 9 games: 483-247 (66%). By confidence: 70%+ hit 83% of 193, 65-70% hit 71% of 96, 60-65% hit 62%, and under 60% hit 56%. Higher confidence hit more often, as it should.
Furthest off among confident leans: Walter Clayton Jr. (four unders at 81-94%). He was projected for 4.6 points and scored 15 in fewer minutes than expected (17 vs 20).
postgame: Re-run with the minutes players really got, 112 of the 247 losing leans would have been right, so minutes caused 45% of the misses.
Players got 2.0 fewer minutes than projected on average (typical miss 6). Projections by stat were close: points −0.5, PRA −0.7, and rebounds, assists and threes within 0.2.
improving: Refit Monday morning on every box score; all 5 stat models passed the test on unseen games.
Team scoring correction kept: 65%+ leans hit 66.7% with it vs 65.9% without on unseen seasons.
New rule from this result: picks now need a player who has started 60%+ of this season's games with 24+ minutes. Last season's role let Javon Small through.
